{{Top|Leg}}
'''WD condenser pods''' were a type of starship component used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ISb">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> Salvager [[Kanda Farral]] of ''[[The Lucky Find]]'' encountered some WD condenser pods in the cloud of debris jettisoned by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] fleet as they left the planet [[Jerijador]]<ref name="ISb" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> ''The Lucky Find's'' retrieval droids struggled to bring the pods back to the salvage ship.
